notes: Manuscript page (5), pencil 23. A sphere sketch supplies six base vertices and a/b paths, followed by their relations, loop identifications and transport under tau, epsilon0, sigma-infinity and rho. The acting group is a curled G_J, not H’s tilde-fraktur-S. The prose after (4) says “de façon simplement transitive”; the crossing f belongs to façon and is not an illegible annotation of the product above. The first a factor in (2b) is visibly a_i^omega, while its later factors and the definitions make that literal product fail the endpoint check: after the preceding five factors, the required closing factor is a_(omega i)^(omega-prime). Expanding the tilde-b product of (8) yields this latter factor. The source formula is retained. The image of l1 in (4) has a doubtful inverse-b index and other literal indices which do not give a based loop under (1); no formula has been repaired from that expectation. The tau and sigma formulas for l-infinity agree with l-infinity=(l1 l0)^(-1) and left conjugation int(h)(x)=h x h^(-1). Under ordinary function composition, rho^(-1)=epsilon0 sigma-infinity and the displayed rho cycle instead give epsilon0 squared = int(l0)^(-1), whereas the page writes epsilon0 squared=l0. This is a convention-dependent inconsistency, not grounds to change the ink. The prime after sigma-infinity(l0) is a literal stray tick. The NB says the tilde-b set is not stable under tau and proposes also taking its tau images. The right edge of (4), the overwritten last number, the cancelled b and the thick inverse-b index remain doubtful. The faint angular trace and isolated stroke/dots are reproduced without assigning them mathematical meaning.
